items.item_text: Community health worker training or certification
One or more years of experience in social services or care coordination, specifically serving older adults, behavior health clients or adults with complex chronic conditions

Advocates for individual and community health needs 1.2 Builds individual and community capacity by increasing health knowledge and self-sufficiency through outreach, community education, informal counseling, social support and advocacy
Conducts standardized client intake and risk assessments
Based on assessments, develops and continually updates plan of care based on client-identified health and social services goals

Participates in the ongoing assessment of client needs via in-person, home, in-office, virtual, and/or telehealth appointments, as appropriate. Similarly, follow-up with clients via telephone, home, or other locations where the client can be found, when appropriate.

Collaborates with health providers to develop an integrated, holistic solution to help client access services and improve client health outcomes which includes working closely and cooperatively with other personnel assigned to the same client, including medical providers, behavioral health providers, housing coordinators, legal advocates

Identifies and helps to enroll eligible individuals in federal, state and local private and non-profit health and human services programs which includes assisting clients in completing a variety of applications and forms
